issue.description:
## Genesis Bead
Tied to plan: /home/coding/TWILL/docs/plan/plan.md

## Overview
TWILL (Transcripts Woven Into Lasting Lessons) distills raw agent session transcripts into reviewed, routed, measured lessons about this environment. Independent of agent-transcript-archive: own repo, own schedule, own cursor over raw session JSONL, never reads graph.db (operator decision 2026-09-19).

## Progress
- [ ] Phase 0: Walking skeleton
- [ ] Phase 1: Reader, cursor, redactor, store
- [ ] Phase 2: Detectors D-01..D-06 + digest
- [ ] Phase 3: Rule corpus, coverage, ranking
- [ ] Phase 4: Explain
- [ ] Phase 5: Routing, apply, review states
- [ ] Phase 6: Measure, escalate, retire
- [ ] Phase 7: Other hosts
- [ ] Phase 8 (optional, gated on Open Question 3): retrieval handoff to WARP / NEEDLE PromptBuilder

## Open questions (plan section 16)
1 org-rule-guard denial log ownership (Phase 2) | 2 Explain model + weekly budget (Phase 4) | 3 WARP/NEEDLE handoff schema (Phase 8) | 4 how other hosts are pulled (Phase 7) | 5 observation retention vs DB budget (Phase 6) | 6 whether to detect fabricated work (Phase 6)
issue.title: Genesis: TWILL Implementation

issue.description: Plan: docs/plan/plan.md Phase 0. One settled session traverses reader -> redactor -> store -> detector -> digest. Exit: 'twill ingest --limit 1 && twill digest --stdout' prints a digest naming >=1 observation from a real local session; observation count > 0. Does NOT include cursors for appended files, ranking, coverage, LLM, measurement, timers.
issue.title: TWILL Phase 0: walking skeleton (session -> observation -> digest)

issue.description: Plan Phase 7. TWILL's own pull of other hosts' transcripts - never via agent-transcript-archive's mirror/. Populate the host column; per-host coverage in doctor; a pull failure degrades to 'stale host', never a failed run. Blocked on Open Question 4 (SSH pull vs host-local TWILL reporting up) because it decides whether plaintext copies land on codinghome.
issue.title: TWILL Phase 7: other hosts (lab, bench, agent-sandbox)

issue.close_reason: Nine finalists integrated into docs/plan/plan.md (commit ebdc312), each into the phase that owns it: backtest P4 + lesson frontmatter; change-point/trend, waste attribution and rule earnings P3; guard generator P5; reproduction-first digest, week diff, honest empty state and dead-man's switch P2; session_usage + parse_shape extraction P1; twill brief P6; friction receipts and the ICG catalog as optional external inputs in new section 6.5. Finalist 18 routed to ICG (irrevers-94a42e7f) and consumed here via D-10; TWILL keeps no copy of the list. Open Questions 7 (receipt hook ownership) and 8 (ICG export format) added; ledger destinations recorded. Verified: plan-author score-draft.sh still 36/36, section order 1-17 intact with 6.5 after 6.4, plan pushed to Forgejo.
issue.description: Nine of ten finalists from the 2026-09-19 plan-idea-gen run are adopted into docs/plan/plan.md, distributed across the phases that own them (see docs/notes/ideas-ledger.md): lesson backtest (P4), change-point detection (P3), poka-yoke guard generator (P5), waste accounting (P1/P3), rule earnings and decay (P3/P6), reproduction-first digest with week diff (P2), dead-man's switch and parser-drift alarm (P1/P2), friction receipt hook as an optional external input (P2 + open question), twill brief pull-only (P6). Finalist 2 (always/never events) is NOT adopted here: that catalog belongs to ICG (irreversible-command-gate); TWILL consumes it and reports gate gaps instead of maintaining a second copy. Also update the ledger verdicts and section 17.
issue.title: Integrate plan-idea-gen 2026-09-19 finalists into plan.md

issue.description: Plan Phase 5. Routing recommendation (environment > hook/gate > wrapper > skill > AGENTS.md > memory > retrieval-only); 'twill apply' EMITS the bead-create command for the owning repo and never executes it; accept/dismiss/apply state machine that refuses to auto-accept. Open-path audit test proves no write outside ~/TWILL and ~/.local/state/twill.
issue.title: TWILL Phase 5: routing, apply, review states

issue.description: Plan Phase 4. Bounded prompt builder (<=8KB/cluster, <=64KB total, excerpts framed as untrusted data), claude -p with CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION and CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID unset (EC-09), strict JSON schema, validation, draft lesson files, 'twill explain --dry-run'. Fails closed on invalid output (exit 4, zero lessons). Golden-prompt test; no fixture secret in the prompt.
issue.title: TWILL Phase 4: Explain (bounded, schema-validated claude -p)

issue.description: Plan Phase 3. Index MEMORY.md + leaves, CLAUDE.md, repo AGENTS.md, skills into rule_doc/rule_fts; coverage matching by content hash + FTS (EC-11); scoring; detectors D-07 rediscovery, D-08 stale-rule, D-09 unread rule docs. Done: a seeded covered cluster is suppressed, an uncovered one stays open, and D-08 finds the live MEMORY.md 'bf, never br' vs CLAUDE.md 'bead is canonical' contradiction.
issue.title: TWILL Phase 3: rule corpus, coverage matching, ranking

issue.description: Plan Phase 6. Daily 'twill measure' re-runs each accepted lesson's versioned detector (EC-12) and mirrors counts to measurements/<lesson>.jsonl; escalate when recurrence is not down >=50% after 21 days; propose retire after 90 days of zero plus an unread rule doc. The digest reports TWILL's own lessons drafted/accepted/applied/resolved over 60 days and says so loudly at zero (risk R1).
issue.title: TWILL Phase 6: measure, escalate, retire, self-measurement

issue.description: Plan Phase 1. Full enumeration of ~/.claude/projects and ~/.codex/sessions, settle window, append/rewrite/truncate handling (EC-01..EC-05), redaction at the persistence boundary, schema + additive migrations, 'twill status --json'. Done: parser/cursor/redactor unit tests, idempotency property test, secret-fixture test, real-corpus ingest within the Section 12 budget, doctor clean.
issue.title: TWILL Phase 1: reader, cursor, redactor, store

issue.description: Plan Phase 2. Detectors: D-01 missing binary, D-02 recurring error signature, D-03 retry loop, D-04 hook denial, D-05 rejected tool call, D-06 interrupt-then-correction. Wire the org-rule-guard denial log as an input (hook owns the log, TWILL reads it - see Open Question 1). Regression oracle: the 30-day digest reproduces the 2026-09-19 probe counts (sqlite3 1096 / bf 697 / go 632 distinct sessions, +/-5%).
issue.title: TWILL Phase 2: detectors D-01..D-06 + weekly digest
